dedupe_keys.name: site investigation data from kawaihae harbor island of hawaii

description: Site investigation data from Kawaihae Harbor, Island of Hawaii is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Diane Moug, Portland State University (pdx.edu). The project performed geotechnical site investigation at the Kawaihae Harbor site with the NHERI@UTexas large mobile shakers. The project collected cone penetration test (CPT) data profiles, and seismic pressure-wave and shear-wave velocity profiles. Bulk soil samples were collected for laboratory characterization. Soils at the site consisted of calcareous deposits and dredged soil. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: calcareous sand, site investigation, cone penetration test, seismic. Published 2025-08-26. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
